name: Nethergarde Keep
summary: Nethergarde Keep watches the Dark Portal from the bluffs above the road into the Blasted Lands. The Alliance raised it after the Second War to guard the dormant gateway and the red wastes beyond. Mages and soldiers, supplied by Stormwind, keep watch against demons and lingering corruption.

sections.title: A Sentinel Against the Red World
sections.body: After the Dark Portal fell at the end of the Second War, Archmage Khadgar and the Alliance of Lordaeron knew the rift could not go unguarded. So the Alliance raised bastions, barracks, and mage spires along the canyon pass into the Blasted Lands. Kirin Tor sorcerers took their posts in the keep. They watched the shattered gateway and wove wards to keep demonic blight from creeping north into the human kingdoms.

sections.title: The Lonely Vigil
sections.body:
When the Dark Portal reopened, the Alliance Expedition crossed into Draenor. Khadgar and his companions sealed the gateway behind them, leaving Nethergarde to guard its silent remnant. For two decades, scholars from Dalaran and the Wizard's Sanctum have studied the portal's lingering energies, mutated local fauna, and demonic incursions.

After Dalaran was ravaged during the Third War, Stormwind City became the keep's sole source of vital supply caravans. Its soldiers and mages now stand alone against the horrors haunting the wasteland.

faq.answer: After the Second War, Archmage Khadgar and the Alliance of Lordaeron commissioned Nethergarde Keep to guard against another orcish invasion from Draenor and contain demonic corruption spreading through the Blasted Lands.
The Alliance of Lordaeron raised Nethergarde Keep at Archmage Khadgar's urging after the Second War. Wizards of Dalaran's Kirin Tor chiefly staffed it.

faq.q: Who commands and supplies the fortress now?
faq.answer: Stormwind now provides Nethergarde Keep with troops, regular supply caravans, and logistical support. Dalaran's Kirin Tor once maintained the keep, but Dalaran fell to the Scourge and the Legion.

faq.q: What are the mages inside the keep studying?
faq.answer: Researchers from the Wizard's Sanctum study the dormant energies of the Dark Portal, mutations afflicting local wildlife, and ways to ward off the fel taint lingering over the red landscape.

angles.text: As a mage, you know Nethergarde as a place where Kirin Tor mages have spent decades studying dimensional rifts, sealing them, and holding back fel corruption.
As an Alliance member, you know Nethergarde as a forward stronghold built with blood and gold to keep the horrors of the First and Second Wars from passing through the portal again.
